# The Spark Studio

> The Spark Studio designs and engineers high-performance Framer templates, visual CMS platforms, and custom software for founders, architecture studios, and luxury brands worldwide.

The Spark Studio builds production-ready digital flagships engineered for 95+ PageSpeed scores, zero-code editing, and native Framer AI Agent skills.

## Core Templates

- [Onyx Atelier](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/onyx-atelier): Monolithic dark luxury architecture and design studio portfolio template with custom smooth interactions.
- [Mavric Estate](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/mavric-estate): Editorial luxury real estate agency and architectural property showcase with dynamic CMS filters.
- [TESSOVRA](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/tessovra): Architectural stone, surface, and luxury tile showroom template with interactive specifiers.
- [TERRA](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/terra): Quiet, editorial furniture and object design atelier showcase with tactile layout.
- [SASSO Architect](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/sasso-architect): Bespoke architectural monograph portfolio engineered for high-ticket design firms.
- [SOLUM](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/solum): Tactile craft, joinery workshop, and artisan lighting monograph with interactive making timeline.
- [Aurelle Estates](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/aurelle-estates): Ultra-luxury flagship real estate brokerage and development portfolio template.
- [Vellum Edition](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/vellum-edition): Editorial monograph typography and studio portfolio for architects and interior designers.
- [Halden Edition](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/halden-edition): Nordic minimalist furniture atelier, objects catalogue, and studio template.
- [Grain & Form](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/grain-form): Solid timber craft, bespoke joinery, and Scandinavian furniture studio template.
- [Slowgrain](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/templates/slowgrain): Heirloom solid timber furniture and architectural craft portfolio template.

## Services & Custom Engineering

- [Custom Framer Development](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/#services): Bespoke Framer website design and engineering with fluid 60fps micro-interactions and dynamic CMS.
- [Figma to Framer Conversion](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/#services): Pixel-perfect migration of Figma design systems into responsive, production-ready Framer platforms.
- [Framer Template Customization](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/#services): End-to-end brand adaptation, typography, color palettes, and custom section builds.
- [Core Web Vitals & PageSpeed Optimization](https://www.thesparkstudio.digital/#services): Asset compression, code trimming, and performance engineering targeting 95+ scores.
